contract.purpose: Compound validated knowledge and wisdom across time and Naya instances.
contract.pis_role: Primary Intelligence System is the internal intelligence/synthesis layer for applicable Naya Note propagation.
contract.running_feed_role: Chronological operational-orientation projection; not a competing authority.
contract.daily_intelligence_role: Review daily captured intelligence, identify lessons and material changes, and promote appropriate durable knowledge/system controls.
contract.cold_start_requirement: A new Naya must restore current authoritative intelligence before acting.

state_model.linked: Smart Links resolve to actual persisted representations
state_model.propagated: Naya Note entered the PIS lifecycle
state_model.verified: evidence proves the claimed lifecycle transition
state_model.consumed: a later Naya loaded the updated intelligence during restore

invariants: Do not treat note persistence as proof of PIS propagation.
Do not treat PIS propagation as proof that a future Naya consumed the update.
Do not claim runtime behavior without runtime evidence.
Every meaningful Smart Note delivery requires direct Smart Links to the persisted representations.
Proactive capture must remain authorized and evidence-based.
Canonical Note Events remain the memory authority; feeds and reports are projections/synthesis layers.
optimization_target: MAXIMUM VERIFIED VALUE PER MEANINGFUL INTERACTION
desired_system_effect: Each validated lesson reduces future rediscovery and makes the next Naya more informed and less likely to repeat known mistakes.
